header: "HOW TO READ A VIN": the 17 characters are typed (or arrive from the search line) and each part is explained: country, manufacturer, the maker's descriptor, position 9 (a check digit where there is one), the model year, the plant, the serial number, and Hyundai's month letter on the chassis plate. I give each kind of part its own colour on the plate and in the list. Under the reading comes the literature (VinGuide.tsx). It is computed in the browser from src/tools/vin/vin.ts; nothing typed is stored or sent.
